# has title

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasTitle`](gmeow-hasTitle.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasTitle>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

Relates a creative work to a structured [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md) it bears; the creative-work-scoped specialization of [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md). Non-functional — a work bears many co-equal titles (original, translated, transliterated, regional); none is primary, and superseded ones set [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false. The structured replacement for the flat [`gmeow:title`](gmeow-title.md) literal when multilingual or statement-level metadata is needed.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md)

Use [`gmeow:hasTitle`](gmeow-hasTitle.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
